copy.headline:
The dough rises.
So does the owner.
copy.introduction: A neighborhood pizzeria for the living, the dearly departed, and anyone who said they only wanted one slice. Our founder still checks the oven. He has been off payroll since 1913. Come for blistered crust, stay for the garlic knots, and please stop asking the portrait for a discount.

pizzas.name: Mushroom Afterlife

bites.name: Burial Burrata

bites.name: Graveyard Meatballs

bites.name: Crypt Caesar

sweets.name: Tiramisu Mortem

sweets.name: Dearly Departed Cannoli
sweets.description: Two crisp shells with sweet ricotta, chocolate, and pistachio. Neither left a forwarding address.

sweets.name: The Haunted Sundae
sweets.description: Vanilla gelato, cherry sauce, and chocolate soil. Disturb gently.

drinks.name: Blood Orange Soda

drinks.name: Little Ghost Cocoa
drinks.description: Warm cocoa with marshmallow. For the recently chilled.

drinks.name: Wake-Up Espresso
drinks.description: A double espresso. The owner has misunderstood its purpose.

drinks.name: Dead Man’s Draft
drinks.description: A fictional house lager, served cold enough to raise questions.

drinks.name: Last Call Negroni
drinks.description: Gin, bitter aperitivo, and sweet vermouth. Equal parts; disputed inheritance.

brief.objective: Present a premium steakhouse concept with clear menu pricing and a satirical old-money hospitality voice.
brief.occasion: Halloween supper service for special occasions and otherwise ordinary Thursdays.

brief.callToAction: Explore the cuts and imagine an evening at the chop house.

copy.headline:
A cut above.
Six feet below.
copy.introduction: An intimate chop house for people who enjoy a good steak and a lengthy explanation of the chair. Expect seared cuts, restrained candlelight, and a cellar committee whose members have technically stopped attending. Our maître d’ can find your table. Your ancestral seat is another department.

arrival.detail: Find your bearings. The host is alive, employed, and prepared to help.

pizzas.name: Ribeye in Perpetuity
pizzas.description: A 14 oz ribeye with peppercorn butter and roasted shallot. A substantial estate.

pizzas.name: Filet of the Deceased
pizzas.description: An 8 oz filet with red-wine jus and glazed shallots. Impeccably tender. Professionally discreet.

pizzas.name: The Heir Apparent Strip
pizzas.description: A 12 oz strip steak with bone-marrow butter. Succession has never looked so well seared.

pizzas.name: Porterhouse for the Executors
pizzas.description: A 32 oz porterhouse to share, with herb butter and roast garlic. Requires two signatures.

pizzas.name: Lamb of the Last Testament
pizzas.description: Roasted lamb chops, rosemary jus, and fondant potato. Please initial beside the mint.

pizzas.name: Mushroom Mausoleum
pizzas.description: Roasted portobello, wild-mushroom ragout, parmesan polenta, and thyme butter. A fine place to settle.

bites.name: Estate Tartare
bites.description: Hand-cut beef, capers, shallot, egg yolk, and toasted sourdough. Served raw; the family requested transparency.

bites.name: Ancestral Onion Soup
bites.description: Slow-cooked onion in beef broth, Gruyère toast, and a lid of quiet authority.

bites.name: Buried Bone Marrow
bites.description: Roasted bone marrow, parsley salad, and sourdough. The trustees approve of spreading the wealth.

bites.name: The Heirloom Wedge
bites.description: Iceberg, blue cheese, tomato, and chive dressing. Old money, newly chilled.

sweets.name: Crème Brûlée Bequest
sweets.description: Vanilla custard beneath a brittle caramel lid. Break the seal in the presence of witnesses.

sweets.name: Black Tie Forest
sweets.description: Chocolate cake, cherries, and whipped cream. Formalwear for a very dark wood.

sweets.name: The Cheese Executor
sweets.description: Three cheeses with fruit preserve and crackers. Distribution at the discretion of the table.

drinks.name: Old Money Fashioned
drinks.description: Bourbon, bitters, sugar, and orange oils. A small fortune on a large cube.

drinks.name: Widow’s Martini
drinks.description: Gin, dry vermouth, and a lemon twist. Very dry; the condolences are optional.

drinks.name: House Red in Trust
drinks.description: A fictional house red by the glass. Vintage and producer await the cellar’s written statement.

drinks.name: Bloodline Fizz
drinks.description: Blood orange, rosemary, lemon, and sparkling water. No disputed parentage.

drinks.name: The Designated Heir
drinks.description: Blackcurrant, lime, and soda. Someone must get the estate home.

copy.headline:
Great racks.
Grave decisions.
copy.introduction: A 21+ Halloween sports lodge serving smoked rib racks, cold drafts, and enough screens to monitor a minor apocalypse. Our adult hosts wear campy lumberjack pin-up uniforms; the ghosts wear whatever they died in. Come for the game. Stay because overtime has become a supernatural event.

arrival.detail: Find your bearings. The host is alive, employed, and prepared to help.

pizzas.name: The Great Rack
pizzas.description: A half rack of smoked pork ribs, bourbon barbecue glaze, slaw, and fries. Bone structure: outstanding.

pizzas.name: Double Dare Rack
pizzas.description: A full rack of smoked pork ribs with slaw and fries. For ambitious appetites and shared custody of the napkins.

pizzas.name: Resting Witch Burger
pizzas.description: A beef patty, smoked cheddar, bacon, pickles, and lodge sauce. A severe expression, a warm center.

pizzas.name: Hot Ghoul Chicken
pizzas.description: Crispy chicken, chili glaze, pickles, and slaw on a bun. The heat signed its own waiver.

pizzas.name: Deadwood Smash
pizzas.description: Two beef patties, American cheese, griddled onion, and mustard. Two hits, no comeback.

pizzas.name: The Veggie Vixen
pizzas.description: A bean-and-mushroom patty, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato relish. No meat, plenty of main-character energy.

bites.name: Boo Bites Wings
bites.description: Chicken wings with buffalo sauce and blue-cheese dip. A little flapping never hurt a scoreboard.

bites.name: Loaded Lumberjacks
bites.description: Fries, smoked pork, cheddar, scallions, and lodge sauce. Off-duty forestry work.

bites.name: Haunted Hoops
bites.description: Beer-battered onion rings and ranch dip. Circles of questionable influence.

bites.name: Nachos of the Living Dead
bites.description: Corn chips, black beans, queso, jalapeños, salsa, and sour cream. They keep coming back.

sweets.name: Cheesecake After Dark
sweets.description: Vanilla cheesecake, blackberry sauce, and chocolate crumbs. A very tasteful scandal.

sweets.name: Afterlife Brownie Points
sweets.description: Warm chocolate brownie, vanilla ice cream, and caramel. Reputation management by the spoonful.

sweets.name: Pumpkin Spice Sinner
sweets.description: Pumpkin bread pudding, cinnamon cream, and caramel. Confession available on the feedback card.

drinks.name: Cold Shoulder Lager
drinks.description: A fictional house lager. Colder than a ghosted group chat.

drinks.name: Lumberjack-o’-Lantern
drinks.description: Bourbon, apple, lemon, and cinnamon. Plaid in a glass.

drinks.name: Resting Beach Face
drinks.description: Rum, pineapple, lime, and a splash of ginger. The lodge has no beach; management has commissioned a sign.

drinks.name: Designated Monster
drinks.description: Blackberry, lime, mint, and soda. Fully present, suspiciously responsible.

drinks.name: Banshee Ginger Fizz
drinks.description: Ginger beer, orange, lime, and sparkling water. Considerably quieter than advertised.

faqs.question: Is this a real restaurant?
faqs.answer: No. BooBies Lodge is a fictional Halloween parody property. Names, food, prices, facilities and policies are invented for creative exploration.

faqs.question: Who is this concept for?
faqs.answer: Adults 21+ seeking sports-bar food, game-night atmosphere, Halloween camp and cheeky lodge hospitality.

faqs.question: Can I book or order here?
faqs.answer: This creator workspace and its marketing pack do not accept bookings, orders, payments or mailing-list subscriptions.

faqs.question: What about allergies and access?
faqs.answer: Ingredients and V tags are working copy, not allergy assurances. Access and sensory details are fictional intentions and require real-world confirmation before use.

faqs.question: Do the outdoor spaces cost extra?
faqs.answer: No. The imagined house spaces and collection are free to explore; food and drinks have separate menu prices. You can skip any part of the itinerary. 21+ only in this fictional lodge concept. All hosts are adults. Costumes are camp; respectful behavior is required.

faqs.question: How does the visit planner work?
faqs.answer: Choose a concept date, an offered arrival, your party size and the spaces you want to explore. Save keeps the plan in this browser for this property. Downloads are fictional itineraries, not tickets or reservations.

faqs.question: What happens after dark?
faqs.answer: Halloween decorations and theatrical lighting are imagined. Sports audio and lively bar noise are part of the 21+ lodge concept. Outdoor spaces are weather dependent. No real facilities or operating policies are promised.
